gamerule.qiusmobEnableBossAI.description: Whether the Death Monarch's AI (auto-targeting and attacking) is enabled
gamerule.qiusmobCanAttackBoss.descriptio: Whether players can damage the transformed Boss avatar (false=invulnerable)
gamerule.qiusmobDeathCanSubjectiveAttack: Whether the Death Monarch actively seeks and attacks targets (false=passive counterattack only)
gamerule.qiusmobBinding.description: UUID hash of the bound player, only this player can transform into the Death Monarch
gamerule.qiusmobSkirkBinding.description: UUID hash of the bound player, only this player can transform into Skirk
gamerule.qiusmobDevourerOwner.descriptio: UUID hash of the bound player, the Devourer only targets entities around this player
